_provenance.unitRule: [UNKNOWN] The unit of utilization is not established: sdk.d.ts:5587 declares only `number`. _provenance.status: NONE of these objects was captured from a live stream. They are written to the declared shape so a consumer can be tested against the presence/absence matrix. Values are illustrative under the unconfirmed fraction hypothesis.
_provenance.sanitization: identifiers are placeholders; no credential-like string appears in this file

expectedCanonical._note: holds only if the fraction hypothesis is true ([INFERRED], unconfirmed)

warningWithoutPercentage.comment: The most common real shape for the five-hour window in this workspace: status plus a reset, no utilization. Unknown must stay unknown.

rejectedWithoutReset.comment: Declared shape (resetsAt is optional, sdk.d.ts:5585); not seen in the corpus. A fallback lockout TTL is Cretli's own number and must never be displayed as a provider reset.

statusOnlyReading.comment: No rateLimitType, no resetsAt, no utilization: still a legitimate event and a legitimate stored row (24 such rejected Claude rows were reported by an earlier read of plan-limits.jsonl on 2026-10-12, [UNVERIFIED] in round 3). Must not be coerced into a default window.

overLimitFraction.comment: Under the [INFERRED] fraction hypothesis (binary string: values above 1 occur when usage runs past a window's cap) a value above 1 is possible; unconfirmed on a payload. A clamp to 100% must not be reported as the measurement.

expectedCanonical._note: holds only if the fraction hypothesis is true ([INFERRED], unconfirmed)

perModelAndOverageWindows.comment: DECLARED ONLY, never observed in this workspace. Present so a consumer can be written to tolerate an unknown window type rather than a fixed pair.

overageAndScopeFields.comment: DECLARED ONLY. Shows that a rejection can be an entitlement state rather than a quota: `overageStatus: 'rejected'` with `overageDisabledReason` means extra usage cannot cover the send. None of these fields is persisted by Cretli today.
